newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products steady to easier.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products steady to easier.

text.p: NWE oil products were steady to easier on Monday, traders said.
Naphtha cargoes were strongly bid by traders said covering shorts and one was heard bidding as high as $231 by the end of the day. Meanwhile a 10Kt Russian cargo moved at $214 a tonne.
Gasoline barges, which traded up to $208.50 earlier, were offered down to $205 a tonne as gas oil lost ground.
Gas oil lost about $2 a tonne, coming under pressure from futures, although premiums held broadly steady.
Cracked fuel oil ended softer as crude retraced early gains, and early refinery barge short-covering petered out.
